name: Toxic / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A hollow muffled toxic cloud eruption with a papery rustling spore texture, followed by irregular dusty poison pulses and a dry fluttering decay. No liquid bubbling. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
